title: V1094 Scorpii: A rare giant multi-ringed disk around a T Tauri star
question: What is the structure of the extended multi-ringed disk around V1094 Sco, and how common are such large disks in Lupus?

what.value: Stellar luminosity and accretion rate of V1094 Sco

evidence.quote: V1094 is a K6 star with a luminosity of 1.7 (1.95) L$_{\odot}$

what.value: GQ Lup Band 7 fluxes used to recalibrate Band 7 flux scale

evidence.quote: it is safe to compare these data with the (cite: macgregor17) results to re-calibrate the Band 7 fluxes

what.value: Temperature profile T(R)=99.3 K (R/1AU)^-0.68 from SED fit
Lupus disk continuum radii and fractions (large disks, transition disks)

recipe.goal: Measure integrated continuum flux and disk geometry
recipe.method: Curve-of-growth aperture photometry; imfit 2D Gaussian for PA, inclination, center

recipe.goal: Fit radial intensity profile in uv-plane to locate rings and gaps
recipe.method: Gaussian times cosine model Fourier transformed and fit to deprojected visibilities binned in 10 klambda; baselines < 700 klambda
key_parameters: up to n=4 terms, 13 free parameters; rho ranges at least 100 klambda wide

recipe.method: Re-image both bands with common 0.25'' circular beam and uv range 17-1260 klambda; compute alpha per pixel after deprojection, radially average
assumptions: 10% flux calibration error in both bands gives 0.42 error on alpha

recipe.goal: Test cold optically thick inner disk with brightness temperature and models
recipe.method: Brightness temperature of peak assuming optically thick; compared to Tsukagoshi SED model and DALI grid of 45 models imaged with 0.25'' beam
key_parameters: Rc=250 AU, gamma=0.6, Mdisk fixed 0.1 Msun, h_c, psi, f_ls, chi grid
assumptions: gas-to-dust ratio 100; smooth disks without rings or gaps

recipe.goal: Estimate occurrence rate of giant disks in Lupus
recipe.method: Count disks with continuum radii up to ~300 AU among 95 Class II Lupus sources
